svg.title: From records to latent summaries
svg.desc: Three visible records from day 6 (Warehouse East, Warehouse West, and a shipment to East) enter the context encoder together. Each comes out as a strip of learned numbers. The average of all visible records' strips forms the pooled state. Values are illustrative.
svg.text: Every visible record becomes a token; the encoder returns one learned vector per token.
Illustrative values. Positions in a vector are learned features, not named business fields.
